narrative.title: The Climbing Rope of Cargo Tags
narrative.scenario: A harbor crane hangs inspection tags on a rope: every new tag clips directly onto the rope's head, and removals always take the current head tag. Because each tag links only to the one beneath it, both actions are a single pointer update. Replay a log of clip/remove commands and report what each removal yields.
narrative.inputFormat: A list of operations, each either ["push", value] to attach or ["pop"] to remove the head.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of values produced by every pop operation, in order; a pop on an empty rope yields -1.
constraints: The structure is a singly linked list with head insertion and head removal

testCases.explanation: Head insertion means the most recent tag is always removed first.
Removing from an empty rope yields -1 before any tag exists.

hintLevels: Level 1: The stack top and the list head can be the same node.
Level 2: Push rewires one pointer (new node points at old head); pop advances the head.
Level 3: A null head is the empty signal — return -1 instead of dereferencing it.
